# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old (and later passed away)  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c37 P3](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0003), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P3](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0003), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Agatha Sowerby’s husband (applied mockingly to Thomas Sowerby, but contrasting Obed)  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed was an awkward-looking man with a hunched frame and lengthy iron-gray hair reaching his shoulders. He wore a thick, gentle brown beard continuously from the age of twenty. When dressing for long trips outside Brierley, he wore his finest suit of clothes with a white collar.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Obed was exceptionally quiet, timid, and bashful, preferring to avoid strangers and women. He was reluctant to speak unless necessary and felt uneasy in unfamiliar company. Despite his reserved nature, he possessed a gentle, sympathetic heart and deep empathy. He enjoyed the company of talkative people as long as they handled the conversation without requiring him to speak.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026)_

- Timid and bashful  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Quiet and taciturn  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farming and agricultural work  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>
- Skilled at negotiating certain purchases  <sub>[v1 c25 P5](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0005)</sub>

## Goals

- To secure help for farm work as he aged  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- To provide a comfortable home and happiness for Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004)</sub>

## History

Obed Abernethy resided at Grey Shutters in Brierley with his sister Thirza. Seeking farm help due to his advancing age and heart trouble, he arranged to adopt an orphan boy. Upon driving to Alder River to meet the train, he discovered that an eleven-year-old girl, Nell Harcourt, had been sent by mistake instead. Unable to leave her behind, Obed brought Nell home and quickly grew fond of her chatter, advocating for her to stay. He quietly supported and indulged Nell, buying her a fashionable dress for Christmas despite his intense shyness in local stores. Over the years, he took immense pride in her academic and personal achievements. Obed unexpectedly passed away from his heart condition shortly after Nell won the Avery scholarship, leaving her and Thirza deeply grieving his loss.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c2 P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c3 P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P7](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0007), [v1 c25 P15](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0015), [v1 c32 P46](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0046), [v1 c36 P12](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0012), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041), [v1 c37 P3](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0003), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- Raised at Grey Shutters on the outer border of his father's farm in Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
